operations.description: This is the main search endpoint allowing queries against the records database.
operations.summary: Run queries against DigitalNZ metadata search service.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] records format [PARAMS] and authentication bbox category century collection commercial content creator date dc decade direction exclude facets field fields filter filters format from geo has is large lat lng or page partner per placename primary sort subject text thumbnail title token type url usage use without year [SCHEMA] error field

operations.description: If you know its `record_id` you can use this endpoint to view all metadata associated with that specific record.
operations.summary: View metadata associated with a single record.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] records [PARAMS] authentication fields format id record token [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This feature returns a set of search results that are similar (ie have similar metadata) to a specific record.
operations.summary: The "More Like This" call returns similar records to the specified ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] records more like this format [PARAMS] authentication fields filtering format id mlt record token [SCHEMA]
